notes: Two taḥwīl routes («ح») carry the same saying; the second route writes «عن عبيد الله، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر» again, so each group keeps its own names and the tail is null
«قالا حدثنا» makes Muhammad ibn al-Sabbah and Suwayd ibn Sa'id co-transmitters of one level
Ibn Umar is the Companion whose report («أن رسول الله ... قال») is the saying
